STAT_FREQUENZ_WERT : Frequency at which the impedance measurement has been performed
STAT_LEVEL_WERT : Level of the signal used for the impedance measurement
STAT_KANAL : Channel(s) on which the impedance measurement has been performed
STAT_MESSDAUER_WERT : Duration of the impedance measurement that has been performed
STAT_LAUTSPRECHER_IMPEDANZMESSUNG : Status of the test as integer
STAT_LAUTSPRECHER_IMPEDANZMESSUNG_TEXT : Status of the test as table TTestStatus
STAT_ANZAHL_FEHLERHAFTE_KANAELE_WERT : Number of the faulty channels (or loudspeakers if the frequency parameter is used)
STAT_FEHLER_1_KANAL : Xth faulty channel as table TAudioKanal WERT
STAT_FEHLER_1_KANAL_TEXT : Xth faulty channel as table TAudioKanal TEXT
STAT_FEHLER_1_FEHLERART_KANAL : Type of error of the Xth faulty channel as integer
STAT_FEHLER_1_FEHLERART_KANAL_TEXT : Type of error of the Xth faulty channel as table TKanalFehlerArt
STAT_FEHLER_1_MESSWERT_SPANNUNG_WERT : Voltage measured on the faulty channel in mV
STAT_FEHLER_1_MESSWERT_STROMSTAERKE_WERT : Electricity measured on the faulty channel in mA
